subject.title: Skills silently truncated - user-created skills invisible with no warning or prioritization

question: Should OpenClaw address skills prompt overflow with the open omitted-key visibility fix first, a new priority/pinning config surface, a broader smart/lazy skill index, or a staged combination?
rationale: The source-backed bug is real, but the remaining solutions change prompt policy and config/API shape rather than a single strict bug fix.

options.title: Stage visibility first
options.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/42637 as the narrow recovery path, then decide priority/pinning and smart indexing separately.

options.title: Design priority config first
options.body: Pause prompt-format changes until maintainers define the supported pinned or high-priority skill contract and migration/docs expectations.

options.title: Fold into smart indexing
options.body: Treat this as part of the broader lazy skill search direction tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/89361 and avoid incremental prompt-list changes except urgent visibility fixes.

recommendation.title: Stage visibility first
recommendation.body: Review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/42637 as the narrow recovery path, then decide priority/pinning and smart indexing separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent history on the current skills loading/docs surface and is the best available routing candidate for a config/product-policy choice.
